skill_yaml:
skill: obstacle_reach
skill_type: arm_gripper
phases:
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: contact_detected
- id: insert_1
  type: insert
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: admittance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    insertion_depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.15
    insertion_force:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 1.0
      - 20.0
- id: grasp_1
  type: grasp
  control: position_control
  termination: time_limit
  end_effector_action: force_grasp
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1

skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: lift_clear
  anchor: world
  offset:
  - 0.35
  - 0.0
  - 0.4
  weight: 0.15
- id: over_obstacle
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.25
  weight: 0.3
- id: final_goal
  weight: 0.55
phases:
- id: lift_z
  type: lift
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    tolerance: 0.01
  parameters:
    lift_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.15
      default: 0.08
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    lift_z_offset:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.15
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: lift_clear
- id: approach_over
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.25
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.03
      - 0.15
      default: 0.08
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    over_clearance_z:

      range:
      - 0.15
      - 0.35
      default: 0.25
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: over_obstacle
- id: descend_to_goal
  type: descend

  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:

  parameters:

      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: final_goal
